name: Settings Example
author: byo-pop examples
description: Values you set in the mod menu (F2): the hint cost, when the Timed bar starts to flash, replays and the big-move message. Changed play values use their own high-score table.

settings.label: Hint cost
settings.help: Points a hint costs, times the level's point multiplier.

settings.label: Timed: warn below
settings.help: The time bar flashes once it is below this fraction.

settings.label: Record replays
settings.help: Saves every game to the replay folder.

settings.label: Big move message
settings.help: Shown for a big cascade. The game's header font has capitals only.
